provenance: 200 synthetic single-turn cases authored and frozen before v2 live evaluations. 40 calibration, 160 heldout; eight strata with 25 cases each. Reference labels are engineering judgments by the implementing assistant, not independent human annotation. Old pilot results and labels remain unchanged. No hardware, files, account secrets or real personal data. Heldout results must not be used to change these labels; prompt tuning invalidates that heldout as independent evidence.
